title: AI Product engineering - how AI is changing our products with Patrick Debois
description:
An increasing number of companies are embedding AI natively into their products, creating innovative patterns that enhance customer experiences while simultaneously optimizing AI performance. In this session, I aim to inspire you with real-world examples of AI-powered product features from across the industry. AI is definitely becoming an essential new persona in product design

Patrick Debois, Principal Product engineer AI at Humans and code
Renowned for his groundbreaking contributions to DevOps and DevSecOps, Patrick is once again at the forefront, navigating the evolving intersection of human intelligence, automation, and AI.
